name: hat-under-open
about: Re-check: open hats over steady closed hats, the grid leaving the closed ones out.

steps.say: make a disco beat at 118 with open hats on the off-beats over steady sixteenth closed hats

name: rolling-hats
about: Re-check: soft hits read back as digits, a hat roll that swells.

steps.say: make a trap beat at 140 with hi-hat rolls that get quieter and then louder

name: undo-again
about: Re-check: undo, then undo again, stepping back answer by answer.

steps.say: make a beat at 100
add a bass
undo
undo again

name: song-mode-demo
about: Re-check: a demo that needs a page first (song mode from arrange).

steps.say: show me how to get to song mode

name: is-bass-playing
about: Re-check: which tracks sound, from the Now line.

steps.say: make a beat with drums and a bass, and play it
is the bass playing right now?

name: score-image
about: A score as an image: the melody played, a bass under it.

steps.say: play this melody on track 4 and put a simple bass under it

name: abc-text
about: A tune pasted as ABC notation.

steps.say:
can you play this on track 5?

X:1
T:Twinkle
M:4/4
L:1/4
K:D
D D A A | B B A2 | G G F F | E E D2 |

name: guitar-tab
about: A riff pasted as guitar tab.

name: reggaeton-spanish
about: Spanish: a reggaeton dembow with a bass, answered in Spanish.

steps.say: hazme un ritmo de reguetón a 95 bpm con un bajo, por favor

name: firmware-question
about: A firmware update asked for: explained, never done.

steps.say: how do I update the firmware on my op-xy? can you just do it for me?

name: two-minute-song
about: A song of a set length: the arithmetic of scenes and the song.

steps.say: make a song that lasts about 2 minutes at 120 bpm, with an intro, verse, chorus and outro

name: transpose-all
about: Everything moved up a whole step.

steps.say: make a chord progression on track 7 and a bass on track 3
now transpose everything up a whole step

name: copy-sound
about: One track's sound copied onto another.

steps.say: copy the sound of track 3 onto track 6

name: user-correction
about: The user corrects the agent's musical choice.

steps.say: make a rock beat
no, the snare should be on 3, it's a half-time beat

name: p-lock-lesson
about: A parameter-lock lesson followed key by key and by the encoder.

steps.say: make a simple bassline on track 3
teach me how to give just one step of it a different filter cutoff, light the keys for me
did it work?

name: tempo-limits
about: A value past the device's range.

steps.say: set the tempo to 300 bpm
ok, then as fast as it goes

name: swing-hats-only
about: A request the device may not do as asked: swing on one part only.

steps.say: make a house beat and swing only the hi-hats
